anomalies.observed: On the EPD_Driver sheet, C1 (the input decoupling capacitor on the Display_Power_Switch rail, in parallel with C2 and feeding L1) is drawn with value 0.1uF/16V.
anomalies.expected: The specification's EPD component-matching table lists Meshinger C1 among the 1 µF/25 V group ('C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V | Matches default'), i.e. C1 should be 1 µF/25 V to match the Pervasive Displays reference circuit.

evidence.quote: EPD_Driver sheet: 'C1 0.1uF/16V' on the Display_Power_Switch node (left of L1), next to 'C2 1uF/6.3V'.
C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V | Matches default

anomalies.impact: The boost-converter input bulk capacitance on the switched EPD rail is reduced from the intended 1 µF to 0.1 µF (and the voltage rating from 25 V to 16 V). This deviates from the reference design's G1-group value selection and can increase input voltage ripple/droop and reduce stability of the EPD boost converter under load.

parsed.summary: Tracing the three hierarchical sheets, the power section (FAN53610 EN/MODE/FB/SW wiring, barrel-jack battery disconnect, S1-as-reset, U6 isolation, +3V3/GND distribution), the SKW92A/keyboard/microSD/UART interfaces, and the EPD driver parts (Q1, Q2, R1, R2, L1, U1-U3, C2, and the J1 signal mapping) all match the specification. The one deviation is C1 on the EPD_Driver sheet, drawn as 0.1uF/16V where the spec's directly-sourced component table requires 1uF/25V, reducing the intended boost-input decoupling.
